blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Should the defense panel for the impeachment trial insist that Vice President Sara Duterte was unaware of the documents bearing her signature, it would only prove that the country’s second-highest official is dumb, lawyer Lorna Kapunan said on Friday. Kapunan, one of the private lawyers assisting the prosecution panel, said at a press briefing that it was unacceptable for Duterte’s lawyers to keep using an “I don’t know” alibi to try to exonerate the vice president from alleged wrongdoing.
